mutations.name: a correctness registration is never test-only for proof
kills: proceedsOnNoRepro on a diff of tests and a changeset lets a correctness registration proceed, since its diff makes it test-only for proof

mutations.name: the diff classification is skipped
mutations.find: if ((await testOnlyDiff(port, gate.repo, gate.pr, gate.head)).kind === "test-only") return true;
kills: proceedsOnNoRepro on a diff of tests and a changeset keeps a correctness registration gated once the diff also changes source

mutations.name: a line carrying mutants proceeds
kills: proceedsOnNoRepro on a diff of tests and a changeset keeps a correctness registration gated when its mutation spec is refused

mutations.name: security proceeds too
kills: proceedsOnNoRepro on a diff of tests and a changeset keeps a security registration gated
